verdict.rationale: Dropbox has a public HTTP API with official SDKs and reference docs, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable machine-readable spec: the probe found no OpenAPI or Swagger file at any of the standard paths. SDKs and human-readable reference pages are developer building blocks, not a spec artifact, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
